brands.name: G Boards
brands.short_description: Torquay soft-top surfboards for learners and everyday surf. A third-generation surfing family shaping closed-cell PE softboards since 1999.

models.name: G-Lite Diamond Tail
models.description: Where performance meets safety. Gboards took the safety elements from the Gboard Classic and created what they believe is the safest hi-performance soft board on the market. The G-Lite features a wider plan shape for improved stability and speed, with a diamond tail that can be ridden as a single fin or with twin fins.

models.name: G-Lite Swallow Tail
models.description: Where performance meets safety. The G-Lite Swallow Tail pairs Gboards' closed-cell soft construction with a swallow tail and thruster or twin-fin setups for a hi-performance softboard that still carries the brand's built-in safety features.

models.name: G-Lite The Fun Board
models.description: The G-Lite Fun Machine is built for easy paddling, easy wave catching, and maximum fun. It features Gboards' technically advanced soft construction with a wider plan shape for stability and speed, available in swallow or diamond tail shapes with thruster or twin-fin options.

models.name: GBOARD Classic
models.description: The Gboard Classic is designed for individual use with a wider plan shape for increased stability and added thickness for paddling efficiency. The range suits everyone from children learning to surf up to a 90 kg beginner in a fun, safe surfing environment.

models.name: GBOARD Original
models.description: Gboards' original surf-school softboard line, built with closed-cell PE foam that does not absorb water if punctured. Designed specifically to provide the most fun, safe, and easiest introduction into surfing for surf schools and first-time riders.
